metadata.question: Does the western basin of Lake Erie show evidence of higher phytoplankton biomass than the eastern basin on September 24, 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Sentinel-2 Level-2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) on 2017-09-24 over Lake Erie. If empty, try Level-1C (COPERNICUS/S2). If still empty, widen window to ±3 days for both.
- Western and Eastern basin represented by rectangles positioned well within Lake Erie to avoid land.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds/cirrus using QA60 bits.
- Mask land using NDWI > 0 to retain water pixels.
- Compute NDCI = (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) as a proxy for chlorophyll-a (phytoplankton biomass).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty across attempts: C1.
- If images exist but valid water pixels after masking are zero in either basin: C2.
- If computed means are null/invalid (NaN or abs>2): C3.
- Otherwise compare mean NDCI West vs East; if West > East => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function eeGet(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.evaluate((v, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(v);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var west = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-83.3, 41.60, -82.60, 41.95]); // Western basin core
    var east = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-80.70, 41.85, -79.50, 42.20]); // Eastern basin core
    var aoi = west.union(east);
    var target = ee.Date('2017-09-24');

    // 2. Helper functions
    function maskS2Clouds(img) {
      var qa = img.select('QA60');
      var cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      var cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0)
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }

    function buildNDCI(col) {
      var maskedCol = col.map(maskS2Clouds).select(['B3', 'B4', 'B5', 'B8']);
      var comp = maskedCol.median();
      var ndwi = comp.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI');
      var ndci = comp.expression('(b5 - b4) / (b5 + b4)', {
        b5: comp.select('B5'),
        b4: comp.select('B4')
      }).rename('NDCI');
      var waterMask = ndwi.gt(0);
      return ndci.updateMask(waterMask);
    }

    async function attempt(daysWindow, collectionId, label) {
      var start = target.advance(-daysWindow, 'day');
      var end = target.advance(daysWindow + 1, 'day'); // end exclusive
      var col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId)
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 90));
      var size = await eeGet(col.size());
      var meanCloud = size > 0 ? await eeGet(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')) : null;
      console.log(`${label} ${daysWindow === 0 ? '±0d' : `±${daysWindow}d`} Images: ${size}` + (size > 0 ? ` (mean cloud: ${meanCloud.toFixed(1)}%)` : ''));
      if (size === 0) {
        return { ok: false, foundImages: false };
      }
      var ndciImg = buildNDCI(col);
      // Counts
      var countW = await eeGet(ndciImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: west,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NDCI'));
      var countE = await eeGet(ndciImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: east,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NDCI'));
      if (!countW) countW = 0;
      if (!countE) countE = 0;
      if (countW === 0 || countE === 0) {
        return { ok: false, foundImages: true, noValidPixels: true };
      }
      // Means
      var meanW = await eeGet(ndciImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: west,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NDCI'));
      var meanE = await eeGet(ndciImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: east,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NDCI'));
      if (meanW === null || meanE === null || !isFinite(meanW) || !isFinite(meanE) || Math.abs(meanW) > 2 || Math.abs(meanE) > 2) {
        return { ok: false, foundImages: true, calcFail: true };
      }
      return {
        ok: true,
        label: label,
        days: daysWindow,
        countW: countW,
        countE: countE,
        meanW: meanW,
        meanE: meanE
      };
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Attempts
    var attempts = [
      { days: 0, id: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR', label: 'S2_SR' },
      { days: 0, id: 'COPERNICUS/S2', label: 'S2_TOA' },
      { days: 3, id: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR', label: 'S2_SR' },
      { days: 3, id: 'COPERNICUS/S2', label: 'S2_TOA' },
    ];

    let anyImages = false;
    let hadNoValid = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < attempts.length; i++) {
      let r = await attempt(attempts[i].days, attempts[i].id, attempts[i].label);
      if (r.foundImages) anyImages = true;
      if (r.noValidPixels) hadNoValid = true;
      if (r.calcFail) {
        console.log('Calculation failure on attempt.');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
      if (r.ok) {
        console.log(`Using ${r.label} window ±${r.days}d`);
        console.log(`Valid Pixels - West: ${r.countW}, East: ${r.countE}`);
        console.log(`NDCI Mean - West: ${r.meanW.toFixed(4)}, East: ${r.meanE.toFixed(4)}`);
        var diff = r.meanW - r.meanE;
        console.log(`Diff (W - E): ${diff.toFixed(4)}`);
        if (diff > 0.002) {
          console.log('A');
        } else {
          console.log('B');
        }
        return;
      }
    }

    // 4. Final fallback statuses
    if (!anyImages) {
      console.log('No images found across all attempts.');
      console.log('C1');
    } else if (hadNoValid) {
      console.log('No valid water pixels after cloud masking.');
      console.log('C2');
    } else {
      console.log('Unknown failure.');
      console.log('D');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
